"""P32: build xxl (12 pieces), sha256 it, one sdip ingest under /usr/bin/time -l with --envelope-gib 10.0."""
import hashlib, json, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
RUN, REPO = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
from tests.fixtures.generators.poststack3d import make_poststack3d
RUN.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "status", "--porcelain"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
src = RUN / "xxl.sgy"
with src.open("wb") as f:
    for k in range(12):
        piece = make_poststack3d(RUN / f"piece{k}.sgy", n_inline=300, n_crossline=630, n_samples=1000,
                                 inline_start=100 + 300 * k).path
        with piece.open("rb") as p:
            head = p.read(3600)
            if k == 0: f.write(head)
            shutil.copyfileobj(p, f, 1 << 24)
        piece.unlink()
h = hashlib.sha256()
with src.open("rb") as f:
    for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 24), b""): h.update(b)
argv = ["/usr/bin/time", "-l", str(REPO / ".venv/bin/sdip"), "ingest", str(src), str(RUN / "xxl.mdio"), "--envelope-gib", "10.0"]
t = time.monotonic()
p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=REPO)
m = re.search(r"(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size", p.stderr)
print(json.dumps({"commit": commit, "tree_clean": not dirty, "source_bytes": src.stat().st_size, "source_sha256": h.hexdigest(),
                  "argv": argv[2:], "envelope_gib_raised_for_this_run": 10.0, "exit": p.returncode,
                  "peak_rss_bytes": int(m.group(1)) if m else None, "real_s": round(time.monotonic() - t, 1),
                  "stderr_tail": p.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-25:]}, indent=1))
